SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy.

Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.

YOUR MISSION

Reports to: Regional Visual Merchandiser North

Position Summary:

  • To ensure enhancement of visual representation of each Puma store by continuously updating the look and feel of the space.

  • Fostering VM creativity to front end team through VM trainings, Competitions & Store Audits

  • Alpha execution of Resec which includes Campaigns, Seasonal visual change overs and Key story roll outs

  • Responsible for all formats of stores- EBOs, Partner, SIS & LFR

  • A planned journey for the responsible set of stores (beat plan) to be adhered and shared month on month

Key Objectives:

  • Provide support to store teams to ensure brand and visual merchandising standards are understood and consistently upheld

  • Plan, order and coordinate for VM supplies for seasonal / monthly changes for the set of stores.

  • Train Store Management and Support teams on merchandising standards, proper fixture utilization and techniques

  • Organizing and sending weekly/monthly reports to the Head Office and implementing feedback

  • Maintaining a vendor base for various branded supply elements for the region

  • Fostering VM creativity to front end through VM trainings, Competitions & Store Audits

  • Supporting Key initiatives roll outs by covering all store formats.

Key Performance Indicators:

  • Net Sales

  • Stock Cover

  • Maintaining Vendor Base

Organizational Relationships:

  • Internal: Visual Merchandising Team , Sales Ops Team, Merchandising Team and Project Team

  • External: Execution partners for hangers, Execution partners for mannequins, Execution partners for branded supplies and Execution partners for print media

YOUR TALENT

Eligibility Criteria And Functional Competencies Required:

  • 5+ years of experience

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Fashion Communication / Fashion /Accessories/ Textile Design

  • Work experience as a Visual Merchandiser including design/ execution

  • Demonstrable visual design skills with a strong retail merchandising portfolio

  • Proficiency in Microsoft presentation & excel, Photoshop, Illustrator and other visual design tools

  • Well versed with best practices of VM in Global industry

  • Excelling Photography skill

  • Creative and innovative thinker

  • Acing Number game- analyzing and tracking of the executions done

  • A proficient communicator.

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex,

gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at

PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal

opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience.To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000

employees worldwide.

Why We’re Building a Talent Pool

We’re continuously building our network of experienced talent across Visual Merchandiser/Store Designers who are interested in being considered for full or part-time employment engagements with assignments to work with our enterprise partners. While this is not tied to one specific project, selected candidates may be matched to future employment opportunities based on experience, availability, and alignment with project needs.

What We Look For

  • Concept and develop retail environments, pop-ups, fixtures, and immersive brand experiences
  • Create 2D/3D renderings, floor plans, elevations, and architectural layouts
  • Partner with brand, global store design, construction, and vendors to execute physical experiences
  • Ensure all spatial design solutions meet brand guidelines and functional requirements
  • Support global-to-regional adaptation of store design concepts Design 3D fixtures, displays, podiums, gondolas, and retail structures
  • Create CAD drawings, technical schematics, and production-ready documents Collaborate with engineering, fabrication, and VM teams
  • Ensure feasibility, durability, material accuracy, and cost considerations Produce photorealistic 3D renderings and prototypes
  • Develop planograms, on-counter layouts, window displays, and in-store merchandising Execute seasonal updates, product placement strategies, and display guidelines
  • Collaborate with store design, creative, and retail teams on rollouts Manage vendor kits, props, signage, and merchandising assets
  • Conduct field visits or coordinate with markets for installation accuracy
  • Manage store design calendars, vendor contracts, and production timelines
  • Coordinate construction, fabrication, installation, and rollout logistics
  • Ensure compliance with budgets, brand standards, and regulatory requirements Liaise with global/regional store design teams, procurement, and suppliers
  • Track deliverables and solve in-market issues during rollout

Additional Qualifications (if relevant)

  • Background in managing execution of store design programs & vendors.
  • Experienced in designing merchandising displays, planograms, store visuals.

About Lifted

Lifted partners with enterprise companies to help them scale smarter. We offer a single solution designed to source, contract, manage, and pay contingent talent. For talent in our network, Lifted provides access to enterprise-level projects while handling engagement setup, contracting, compliance, and payments in the background, so you can focus on delivering high-quality work.

Leland is building the home for ambition in the age of AI. We connect people with the experts, programs, and communities they need to land the job, get into the school, or upskill for a world being rewritten by AI. We help businesses become AI-native through training, hiring, and infrastructure. Since our founding in 2021, we've helped tens of thousands of people reach their most ambitious goals and raised $19M from world-class investors. Ambition is sacred to us, and we've built a product that takes that seriously.

We're seeking an experienced retail and merchandising coach to work with students and professionals building careers in retail. This role includes teaching core skills in retail strategy, merchandising strategy, product assortment planning, visual merchandising, and pricing strategy, as well as inventory management, sales forecasting, supply chain management, and store operations. Coaches also help students apply retail analytics, retail marketing, customer experience optimization, e-commerce integration, and AI fundamentals and automation to modern retail work. On the career side, coaches support resume review, cover letters, LinkedIn review, interview prep, and salary negotiation, as well as networking strategy and freelancing for those pursuing independent work. Ideal candidates have professional experience in retail or merchandising, prior coaching or mentoring experience, and a clear, structured approach to breaking down strategic and operational retail concepts. Coaches set their own hours and rates, host sessions virtually, and partner with our team to deliver a high-quality, supportive experience for every student.

Why Leland?

  • The chance to join a world-class team helping people achieve their career and educational dreams

  • Work in a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions have a direct impact

  • Operate in a fast-paced, AI-native environment

  • We don't hire people who merely want to work for a great company; we hire people who want to make a great company

Leland is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds and demographics to apply.

Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business, selling products in Household, Retail Building Materials and Garden Equipment categories, is looking for a talented and experienced Graphic Designer to join their team for a full-time remote job.

About the company:

A leading e-commerce retailer specializing in household essentials, with a strong presence on Amazon and other online marketplaces. With over a decade of success, we are committed to delivering top-quality products and exceptional customer experiences. Our focus is on continuous optimization and growth across digital channels, with 85% of our business driven through Amazon.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a talented and conversion-driven Graphic Designer with deep experience in creating and optimizing Amazon product listings. This role is critical to our growth strategy. Your primary responsibility will be to design high-converting visual content that increases click-through rates(CTR) and conversion rates (CVR) across our Amazon catalog.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design compelling Amazon listing images including main images, infographics, A+ content (EBC), and storefront banners.
  • Optimize visuals specifically to increase clicks and conversions, informed by performance data and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with marketing, content, and product teams to align on messaging and branding.
  • Conduct A/B testing of image sets and monitor performance to continuously improve KPIs.
  • Stay current with Amazon guidelines and evolving trends in e-commerce visual merchandising.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience designing Amazon listing content with measurable impact on CTR and CVR.
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-quality Amazon graphics and performance-driven design.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of how design impacts conversion metrics in an e-commerce setting.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with 3d modelling (3D Max or similar)

Preferred:

- Experience with Amazon A+ Content, Brand Stores, and tools such as Helium 10 or Jungle Scout.

- Background in e-commerce or consumer product design.

Benefits:

Competitive salary

Fully remote flexible full-time job, paid time off
Be part of a fast-growing, data-driven e-commerce company
Opportunity to directly impact the performance and growth of top-selling Amazon listings
Work with a collaborative and results-oriented team that values excellence and innovation.

Company: Lucky 21

Location: Remote

Company Vision

At Lucky 21, we specialize in eCommerce success through strategic design, data-driven solutions, and innovative branding. Our mission is to create visually compelling content that drives engagement and conversions on Amazon and other online marketplaces. As AI continues to transform creative workflows, we're looking for a Creative Coordinator who can combine traditional design expertise with AI-powered content creation to produce exceptional ecommerce listings.

Role Overview

As a Design Coordinator, you will collaborate with the Art Director, Brand Managers, and Marketplace teams to develop high-impact creative assets for Amazon and other ecommerce platforms. You will be responsible for coordinating creative projects, generating and enhancing images using AI tools, optimizing listing content, and ensuring all assets meet brand standards and marketplace requirements.

This role requires someone who understands Amazon listing best practices, has experience in the fashion/apparel category, and is comfortable leveraging AI to improve creative quality and efficiency.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Create and coordinate ecommerce creative assets, including product images, lifestyle images, infographics, A+ Content, brand storefronts, and digital marketing materials.
  • Generate, edit, and enhance product imagery using AI image generation tools while maintaining brand consistency and realism.
  • Work with existing brand assets (Brand Guidelines, PSDs, photography, videos, etc.) to produce compelling ecommerce content.
  • Collaborate with the Creative Director and Brand Managers to develop creative concepts that improve conversion rates.
  • Ensure all creative assets comply with Amazon image requirements and marketplace best practices.
  • Coordinate photography, retouching, AI-generated assets, and design production from concept through final delivery.
  • Upload and organize creative assets while ensuring accuracy and quality across ecommerce platforms.
  • Manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Stay current with emerging AI technologies, ecommerce design trends, and Amazon best practices.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience creating ecommerce creative for Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, or similar marketplaces.
  • Strong experience with Amazon listing images, A+ Content, and Brand Storefronts.
  • Hands-on experience using AI image generation tools such as ChatGPT Images, Claude, or similar platforms.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing ecommerce creative work.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, especially Photoshop and Illustrator. Canva experience is a plus.
  • Experience working with Fashion/Apparel brands is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of ecommerce merchandising and designing for conversion.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail.

Culture

At Lucky 21, we value:

  • Innovation – Embracing new technologies, including AI, to improve creativity and efficiency.
  • Excellence – Delivering high-quality work that drives results.
  • Collaboration – Working closely with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals.
  • Ownership – Taking initiative and following projects through to completion.
  • Growth Mindset – Continuously learning, adapting, and improving.

Benefits

  • Paid Time Off
  • Remote Work Environment
  • Opportunities for Professional Growth
  • Exposure to leading national brands in the ecommerce and fashion industry
